title: Vibrant Luxury Home, Sleeps 12, Close to DT!
description:
Welcome to the Spacious Nashville Haven! Walkable to restaurants & coffee shops and just minutes away from the downtown Broadway scene!

★Modern 3 story spacious townhome
★4-bedroomss, 4 Luxury en-suite bathrooms
★Gourmet Kitchen with high-end appliances
★Centrally located, only minutes to DT
★Perfect bachelorette, bachelor, or birthday retreat spot!
★Walkable to restaurants & coffee shops
★Walkable to Vanderbilt University
★ Walkable to Centennial Park
★ Less than 10 minutes to Broadway

The space
This home is owner-managed and cared for down to the detail—not a hands-off investment property. Every room is set up to make your Nashville stay comfortable, easy, and photo-worthy, with plenty of spots throughout the home worth a picture.

The spacious layout works for any group—family and friends, a bachelorette or bachelor weekend, a birthday, work trip, hospital visit or a couple's retreat. Best part: every bedroom has its own attached bathroom, so getting ready for a night out is easy and private.

★Sleeps 12 — 1 king, 2 queens, 2 doubles, 1 pull-out couch

★1st Floor:
Bedroom #1 — Queen Bed (sleeps 2)
Attached Bathroom — Walk-in Shower
Two-Car Attached Garage
(Minimal steps to enter on this level; one flight up to the main level on the 2nd floor)

★2nd Floor:
Bedroom #2 — Two Double Beds (sleeps 4)
Attached Bathroom — Shower/Tub combo
Living Room w/ Smart TV
Gourmet Kitchen & Coffee Bar
Queen Sofa Sleeper (sleeps 2)
Outdoor Common Area
(Enter step-free through the back door—nearly everything is on one level; stairs only needed for the garage or laundry)

★3rd Floor:
Bedroom #3 — King Bed (sleeps 2)
Attached Bathroom — Huge Walk-in Shower
Bedroom #4 — Queen Bed (sleeps 2)
Attached Bathroom — Shower/Tub combo
Washer/Dryer

★LOCATION — West End, minutes from Downtown:
0.8 mi to Vanderbilt
1.0 mi to Centennial Park
1.5 mi to Midtown
2.5 mi to Lower Broadway, live music, and the honky-tonks
Under 1.5 mi to all 3 major Nashville hospitals

Guest access
This home is equipped with two Smart Locks. There are no keys for added security. You will be given an access code prior to check-in. Access will start at 4pm day of check-in and expire at 10am day of check-out unless a prior arrangement has been made.

Other things to note
NO LOCALS
We don't accept bookings from guests who live in Nashville or within 60 miles, and we ask that you not book if you're local or plan to host local visitors. Local bookings may be canceled at the host's discretion. This helps us protect the home and our neighbors. Thanks for understanding.

CHECK-IN 4 PM / CHECK-OUT 10 AM
Early check-in or late check-out may be available for a $200 fee, subject to our schedule and host pre-approval in advance.

STAIRS
This is a 3-story home with many stairs, and guests will use them throughout their stay. We're happy to host children, but please note the home is not childproofed, so supervise little ones at all times. There is an elevator on-site, but it is turned off and not available for guest use.

PARKING
Two-car garage is available plus free street parking in the neighborhood, available first come, first served.

PET POLICY:
We do not allow pets of any kind at the property. Please respect this policy. If we learn of unknown pets inside the home through security footage or evidence in the home you will be subject to a $500 fine.

We've put a lot of care into this home and love it. We're looking for guests who'll respect the property and our neighbors. Made it this far and have questions? Send us an inquiry. We'd love to host you.
